low.selection: Only already-published full TEST per-client accuracy; no threshold/classifier tuning
low.new_inference: Offline owner validation at class-birth and T5 checkpoints only
low.historical_validation: Offline diagnosis only; never passed to training, router fitting or live clients
low.router_refit: Frozen saved binary sketches only, same balanced LR as previous matched audit
low.oracle: True task used only for a separate diagnostic
low.limitation: Previous validation source, selected worst clients after TEST; not independent confirmation

rounds.role: Owner validation Task 3 only, offline diagnostic
rounds.reconstruction: FP16 base and delta chain, all member checksums verified; compare R19 predictions to exact FP32 terminal
rounds.availability: Saved CANDLE available classes and class_tasks
rounds.oracle: True task only for a separate diagnostic
rounds.causal_limit: Round checkpoints are post-aggregation, no saved pre-aggregation local model; cannot isolate aggregation from local updates

components.evaluation: Owner validation T3, oracle task to isolate classification; not deployed inference
components.selection: R4 selected after observing the existing trajectory, for mechanism diagnosis only
controls: h19 with R4 BN buffers W19
h19 with R4 BN affine and buffers W19
components.precision: R4 reconstructed FP16 archive; R19 exact FP32 terminal. Not a clean training ablation.
components.causal_limit: Mixing checkpoint components identifies functional dependencies, not local-training versus aggregation causality

limitations: Selected clients using already-observed TEST; new diagnostics read validation only.
Owner validation and global balanced development have different distributions; no direct accuracy equivalence.
High pooled owner accuracy can hide rare-class failures.
Round archives use FP16 reconstruction; R19 checked against exact FP32 terminal.
Both head and encoder change; component mixing is not a clean local-training versus aggregation ablation.
Neighborhood alpha is not the effective per-coordinate contribution after label/age/connection masks.
No production behavior changed; no core bug proven solely from missing task participation.
